shared: Knights grow huge by standing alone, with empty slots feeding one or a few champions.
differ: The core rule: bigger units take stats, Knights side by side go blank, or Duels strike before fights.

takes.label: Raid the shop
takes.line: The bigger unit takes a quarter of the smaller's stats, even in the shop: Pilgrim raids it, so refreshes feed your champion.
takes.look_if: refreshing the shop to grow, and a champion from any tribe.

takes.label: Three lonely stations
takes.line: A Knight next to another Knight goes blank; three hold stations, other tribes fill the gaps, and heirs wake when elders die.
takes.look_if: a placement puzzle, and heirs waking mid-fight.

takes.label: Starve the board
takes.line: Start of Combat Duels kill enemies before anyone attacks, gaps pay a vain Champion, and Sir Gottfried grows x4 alone.
takes.look_if: pre-fight kills and one giant knight on a near-empty board.
